rationale: Postponed on the 2025 DUI: the manual refers a recent motoring conviction to judgement, and desk practice postpones a recent DUI rather than rating it. If rated later: occupation class C, three violations and liver enzymes above twice normal (not mild) would carry debits; climbing alongside the hazardous occupation would take an exclusion rider; the cholesterol band yields to the ratio, uncharged. Build, BP, A1c, tobacco, family history and financials are clean. Judgement used on referral lines.
